atoms.clinical_meaning: Persistent albuminuria used as a renal ATTRv red flag when otherwise unexplained; carrier status is not part of the atom definition.
atoms.context_guard: Match albuminuria/microalbumin-specific language. Generic proteinuria remains a separate renal atom; V17 combines persistent unexplained renal findings at the AST level.
Nonspecific renal phenotype. Requires differential evaluation; should not by itself classify AL, AA, or ATTR.

atoms.preferred_name: Monoclonal protein detected on serum immunofixation
atoms.clinical_meaning: Monoclonal protein detected on serum immunofixation; redirects toward AL evaluation/amyloid typing.
atoms.context_guard: AL-workup trigger only; monoclonal gammopathy can coexist with ATTR and must not by itself suppress an ATTR pathway.
